items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: And I played with Jack Snead, a guitar player... We used to go... I remember I'd go down to all these studios, and we'd play, you know, in these studios!

ctx.x: In the YMCA. It was Splicky's(?)... And I played with Jack Snead, a guitar player...he played guitar, man... He was always a cook; he sold hot pies, patties and everything. He used to get me... We used to go... I remember I'd go down to all these studios, and we'd play, you know, in these studios! I never got paid; I got five dollars or something. He took me around, yeah...
Now, you told me once before that one of the first people you heard impress was Earl with Louis -- Earl Hines and Louis Armstrong.
